‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’ ”

It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.”
Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Yahweh has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.
translations.bsb: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
translations.kjv: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
translations.asv: Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth; He will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
